notes.title: Aster One
notes.text: Aster receives first messages, calls and social activity even without saved contacts. Reuse known NPC IDs; incoming events create the sender contact and conversation. New senders may include an incoming profile or public caller name; do not invent established phone numbers. Incoming permissions, blocked contacts and app installation still apply. Confirm actual delivery/call initiation in the story and emit rf-phone events. Player-saved profiles are authoritative. Phone story effects and wallet progress remain reversible; never settle transactions twice.
